name: Rapide

origin.basis: ARISUN is a ZC Rubber (Zhongce, maker of Chaoyang) bicycle-tire brand; the official listing gives the brand as 朝阳 and the item code 艾瑞森H-908.

manufacturing.basis: The retailer pages do not state the factory location.

positioning: ARISUN's 60 TPI folding road clincher sold through US and European retailers rather than mainland marketplaces.

availability.note: Listed by a US retailer (sold out on 2026-11-01); not found in mainland China marketplaces or XHS. A UK retailer listing could not be read.

price_observations.conditions: Retailer price on 2026-11-01 for the 25 mm folding tire; sold out, shipping at checkout.
Retailer price on 2026-11-01 for the 32 mm folding tire; sold out, shipping at checkout.

caveats: Retailer copy claims wet-weather grip from its tread design; no owner report or lab test supports it.
Not sold in the mainland China routes checked; the US listings were sold out on 2026-11-01.
